$comment: The stories on imaginelivetv.com, in the order the landing page lists them. Each one's scenes are in story/<id>.json. Fields: id (the data file's name), logline (one line for its card), image (its card's key image, 9:16; without one the card shows the first video's opening frame) and alt (what the image shows), pages (where its branch pages live: "/" for The Final Spark only, every other story under /<id>/), runtime (a listed story's card and hero say how long one way through takes, e.g. "About 45 min": an editorial estimate, Night Shift's from tools/check-night-shift.mjs), mood (three words on its card), teaser (optional, one line a card carries as data-teaser and the story link page shows; Trust Fall has one so listing it is a single change), featured (true on at most one story: the hero at the top of the landing page), listed (false: built and playable at /?story=<id>, but not on the landing page). Every card wears the player's own progress badge (Not started, Started, Completed: js/game.js, from the story's saved place; its endings are the scenes with an "ending" in story/<id>.json). `npm run story` builds them all. Story doc: story/README.md.

stories.logline: A rat is watching. Every page costs a match.
stories.alt: A rat sitting on a rusted pipe

stories.logline: Forty barrels of water, a dying town on the far side of the desert, and a revolver you've never fired. Every page costs water.
stories.alt: A mourning dove on a dead branch at dawn, a water caravan setting out across the desert below

stories.logline: A placeholder night in a Manhattan tower: a radio check, a door on camera four, and a report with your name on it.
Your first week of nights in a Manhattan tower. Nine cameras of nothing, one trainer who knows every door, and a report with your name on it.
stories.alt: A wall of nine security camera tiles in a dark control room
stories.mood: Slow-burn, uneasy, heard in the dark

stories.logline: A thief who hates the machine, a city it's about to switch on, and a husband who says good morning on the news. Who catches you when you fall?
stories.alt: The words Trust Fall in white on a dark teal background
stories.teaser: It says good morning. Do you believe it?
